## Lib/eacp/Sprites/Fit.h

- enum class `Fit` — eacp::Sprites — Fit.h:11 — How an image is placed when its aspect ratio differs from the area it is drawn into.
  - `Stretch` = 0 — fill the area, ignoring aspect (may distort)
  - `Contain` = 1 — fit entirely inside, letterboxing the remainder
  - `Cover` = 2 — fill the area, cropping the overflow
- fn `Rect fitRect(float areaWidth, float areaHeight, int imageWidth, int imageHeight, Fit fit)` — eacp::Sprites — Fit.h:22 — The destination rect for an imageWidth x imageHeight image inside an areaWidth x areaHeight area under the given fit.
